title: Class chat teachers can manage

validation.message: Instagram Reels dimensions, duration advisory, and frame rate checks passed.

sceneTimeline.narration: Class chat works better when the teacher can shape the space.
Open one whole-class channel or create named groups, choose the profile, manage members, and assign another admin while the teacher retains oversight.
Students can ask, help, and build together inside the classroom community. Meet EdulabsAI.
